# NEW 2026-11-23 v19.0 Module 19.0-C: Scripted Effects & O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook (oe_qol_kernel_yearly, 0 debug_log) (oe_qol_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v190_qol_mp.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# O(1) Zero-Slot Yearly Hook exported for Global Kernel integration.
# Self-deduplicates per calendar year via global_var:oe_qol_ran_y ?= current_year.
# Runs ONLY for human countries (is_ai = no) that explicitly opted in (0 AI overhead).
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_qol_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_qol_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_qol_yearly_runs } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_qol_yearly_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_qol_yearly_runs add = 1 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_qol_human_realm = yes
				oe_qol_any_opt_in = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_qol_marriage_on ?= 1 }
				oe_qol_run_court_marriage_pass = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_marriage_aid_active years = 3 mode = replace }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_qol_tutor_on ?= 1 }
				oe_qol_run_heir_tutor_pass = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_tutor_aid_active years = 3 mode = replace }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_qol_mp_compact_on ?= 1 }
				oe_qol_refresh_mp_compact = yes
			}
			oe_qol_dispatch_yearly_events = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Decision Entry Points (Dispatch oe_qol.1 .. oe_qol.5 cleanly)
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_open_marriage_console = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_human_realm = yes }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.1
	}
}

oe_qol_open_tutor_console = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_human_realm = yes }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.2
	}
}

oe_qol_open_mp_compact = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_human_realm = yes }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.5
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Assistant 1: Opt-In Court Noble Marriage Pass (max 3/yr, preserves ruler/heir)
# Uses save_scope_as = oe_qol_realm so calls from every_country in global yearly
# pulse always target the iterated human realm rather than pulse root.
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_run_court_marriage_pass = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_human_realm = yes }
		save_scope_as = oe_qol_realm
		ordered_character = {
			limit = { oe_qol_marriage_candidate = yes }
			order_by = total_abilities
			max = 3
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { oe_qol_marriage_candidate = yes }
				save_scope_as = oe_qol_suitor
				# Step A: Prefer pairing two existing compatible unmarried courtiers to prevent court bloat.
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:oe_qol_realm = {
							any_character = {
								oe_qol_marriage_candidate = yes
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_qol_suitor }
								NOT = { is_close_relative = scope:oe_qol_suitor }
								can_marry_character = scope:oe_qol_suitor
							}
						}
					}
					scope:oe_qol_realm = {
						ordered_character = {
							limit = {
								oe_qol_marriage_candidate = yes
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_qol_suitor }
								NOT = { is_close_relative = scope:oe_qol_suitor }
								can_marry_character = scope:oe_qol_suitor
							}
							order_by = total_abilities
							max = 1
							check_range_bounds = no
							save_scope_as = oe_qol_match
							scope:oe_qol_suitor = { marry_character = scope:oe_qol_match }
						}
					}
				}
				# Step B: If no existing match is available, arrange a noble-estate spouse of the opposite sex.
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_female = no }
					scope:oe_qol_realm = {
						if = {
							limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
							create_character = {
								religion = scope:oe_qol_suitor.religion
								culture = scope:oe_qol_suitor.culture
								age = { 18 26 }
								female = yes
								estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
								marry_character = scope:oe_qol_suitor
							}
						}
						else = {
							create_character = {
								religion = scope:oe_qol_suitor.religion
								culture = scope:oe_qol_suitor.culture
								age = { 18 26 }
								female = yes
								estate = estate_type:crown_estate
								marry_character = scope:oe_qol_suitor
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					scope:oe_qol_realm = {
						if = {
							limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
							create_character = {
								religion = scope:oe_qol_suitor.religion
								culture = scope:oe_qol_suitor.culture
								age = { 19 28 }
								female = no
								estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
								marry_character = scope:oe_qol_suitor
							}
						}
						else = {
							create_character = {
								religion = scope:oe_qol_suitor.religion
								culture = scope:oe_qol_suitor.culture
								age = { 19 28 }
								female = no
								estate = estate_type:crown_estate
								marry_character = scope:oe_qol_suitor
							}
						}
					}
				}
				scope:oe_qol_realm = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_marriages_done } }
						set_variable = { name = oe_qol_marriages_done value = 1 }
					}
					else = {
						change_variable = { name = oe_qol_marriages_done add = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Assistant 2: Opt-In Royal Heir & Prince Education Pass (max 4/yr)
# Mode 1 = Elite Heir (expensive_in_depth when gold >= 250) + Balanced Dynastic
# Mode 2 = Adaptive Aptitude & Statecraft Track (Adm / Dip / Mil)
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_run_heir_tutor_pass = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_human_realm = yes }
		save_scope_as = oe_qol_realm
		ordered_character = {
			limit = { oe_qol_tutor_candidate = yes }
			order_by = age_in_years
			max = 4
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_qol_realm = { var:oe_qol_tutor_mode ?= 2 } }
				if = {
					limit = { adm >= 25 }
					set_child_education = child_education:administrative_education
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { dip >= 25 }
					set_child_education = child_education:diplomatic_education
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { mil >= 25 }
					set_child_education = child_education:military_education
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:oe_qol_realm = { at_war = yes } }
					set_child_education = child_education:military_education
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:oe_qol_realm = { num_subjects >= 3 } }
					set_child_education = child_education:diplomatic_education
				}
				else = {
					set_child_education = child_education:administrative_education
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_heir = yes
						scope:oe_qol_realm = { gold >= 250 }
					}
					set_child_education = child_education:expensive_in_depth_education
				}
				else = {
					set_child_education = child_education:balanced_education
				}
			}
			scope:oe_qol_realm = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_tutors_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_qol_tutors_done value = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_qol_tutors_done add = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Macro 3: One-Click Batch RGO & Granary Infrastructure Macro (max 5 sites, 60g/site)
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_exec_batch_rgo = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_human_realm = yes }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_qol_rgo_upgrade_candidate = yes }
			order_by = rgo_profit
			max = 5
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { root = { gold >= 60 } }
				root = { add_gold = -60 }
				change_max_raw_material_workers = 1
				change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_bonus
				if = {
					limit = {
						num_civil_constructions = 0
						OR = {
							location_rank = location_rank:town
							location_rank = location_rank:city
							location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
						}
						NOT = { has_building_with_at_least_one_level = granary }
						can_build_building = building_type:granary
						root = {
							gold >= 160
							can_build_building = building_type:granary
						}
					}
					construct_building = {
						building_type = building_type:granary
						cost_multiplier = 1.0
						instant = no
					}
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_rgo_macro_cd years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_rgo_runs } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_rgo_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = oe_qol_rgo_runs add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_3_done } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_3_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.3
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Macro 4: One-Click Regional Trunk Road & Market Connector Macro (max 3 hubs)
# Dispatches real paid construct_road using highest unlocked road tier.
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_dispatch_best_road = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_qol_road_from
			exists = scope:oe_qol_road_to
			scope:oe_qol_road_from = { has_road_constructions = no }
			scope:oe_qol_road_to = { has_road_constructions = no }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { road_type:railroad = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:railroad from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:oe_siberian_trakt = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_siberian_trakt from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:modern_road = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:modern_road from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:oe_via_imperialis = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_via_imperialis from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:oe_yam_post_road = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_yam_post_road from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:oe_amr_qhapaq_nan_road from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:paved_road = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:paved_road from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { road_type:gravel_road = { is_available_for = root } }
			construct_road = { road_type = road_type:gravel_road from = scope:oe_qol_road_from to = scope:oe_qol_road_to }
		}
	}
}

oe_qol_exec_batch_trunk_road = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_qol_human_realm = yes
			oe_qol_has_any_road_tech = yes
		}
		add_gold = -60
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_qol_trunk_hub_candidate = yes }
			order_by = population
			max = 3
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_road_constructions = no
					root = { gold >= 50 }
				}
				save_scope_as = oe_qol_road_from
				ordered_neighbor_location = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner ?= root
						has_siege = no
						has_road_constructions = no
						OR = {
							is_capital = yes
							has_road_to_capital = yes
							is_market_center = yes
							local_control >= 0.55
						}
						NOT = { has_latest_road_to = scope:oe_qol_road_from }
					}
					order_by = local_control
					max = 1
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = oe_qol_road_to
					root = { oe_qol_dispatch_best_road = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_trunk_road_cd years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_road_runs } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_road_runs value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = oe_qol_road_runs add = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_4_done } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_4_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.4
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Macro 5: Optional MP Fair-Play & Late-Game Anti-Snowball Compact Helpers
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_refresh_mp_compact = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_qol_human_realm = yes
			var:oe_qol_mp_compact_on ?= 1
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_fairplay_compact years = 5 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { num_locations >= 160 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t1
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t2 years = 5 mode = replace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { num_locations >= 80 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t2
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t1 years = 5 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t1
			remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t2
		}
	}
}

oe_qol_clear_mp_compact = {
	remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_fairplay_compact
	remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t1
	remove_country_modifier = oe_qol_mod_mp_softcap_t2
}

oe_qol_broadcast_mp_invite = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_qol_mp_is_multiplayer = yes }
		save_scope_as = oe_qol_mp_proposer
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_qol_human_realm = yes
				NOT = { this = scope:oe_qol_mp_proposer }
				NOT = { var:oe_qol_mp_compact_on ?= 1 }
				NOT = { var:oe_qol_mp_invited_y ?= current_year }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_mp_invited_y value = current_year }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.5
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Yearly Milestone Dispatcher for Opt-In Human Realms (oe_qol.6 .. oe_qol.10)
# Max 1 milestone event per year per opted-in human realm; zero AI overhead.
# ==============================================================================
oe_qol_dispatch_yearly_events = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_qol_human_realm = yes
			oe_qol_any_opt_in = yes
		}
		# 6. Charter of Late-Game Administrative Efficiency
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1560
				num_locations >= 30
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_6_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_6_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.6
		}
		# 7. The Great Imperial Urban Census
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1610
				num_locations >= 35
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_7_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_7_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.7
		}
		# 8. Continental Postal & Courier Exchange
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1650
				num_locations >= 35
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_8_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_8_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.8
		}
		# 9. Sovereign Debt & Treasury Rebalance
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1680
				OR = {
					num_loans >= 1
					num_locations >= 40
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_9_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_9_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.9
		}
		# 10. Concert Armistice & Balance-of-Power Protocols
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1720
				OR = {
					at_war = yes
					war_exhaustion >= 2
					num_locations >= 45
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_qol_ev_10_done }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_qol_ev_10_done value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_qol.10
		}
	}
}
